title: Camera recording segment (v1)
description: One finalized (or open) camera video segment on disk. Durations come only from the monotonic clock; OS-provided pixel dimensions are recorded when reported and never invented.

file_path.description: Path relative to the project directory.

checksum_md5.description: MD5 of the finalized file; null while the segment is still open.

duration_s.description: Seconds, measured on the monotonic clock — never estimated.

width_px.description: OS-provided metadata when reported; never invented.

epoch_ms.description: Wall clock (Date.now), UTC — provenance only, can jump.

monotonic_ms.description: Monotonic clock (performance.now origin) — basis for durations and within-boot alignment.
